name: Saturday Tasogare
source:
The main character of vivid/stasis, Saturday Tasogare is a transgender woman who is 19 years old at the start of the story. Her initial motivation is to try and find her sister Tsuki, who went missing shortly before Episode 1.

[spoiler]Later in the story, it is revealed that the protagonist Saturday is one of four pieces of Saturday's mind split off from the original Saturday Tasogare during the Severance of Emotion.[/spoiler]
